notes.title: MP2 - Status Update
notes.notes:
[u][b]Attention Foundation Personnel[/b][/u]

It has been a significant amount of time since our last correspondence and since then we have had our share of ups and downs. Our silence has been unacceptable and we hope to shed some light on the current situation within Northwood Studios.

[h1][u][b]Where is the update? - Current Issues[/b][/u][/h1]

For those who are unaware, we have had many ongoing issues with our networking service and Unity itself. These issues include: The game failing to load, connection issues, game crashes, and Linux builds failing to work.

When it comes to Unity Builds and the bugs encountered from them, we have tried our best to deploy workarounds to these issues. We also made sure to report our problems to the Unity team directly in hopes of later builds resolving the problem. The issues given to the Unity team were confirmed by their QA staff and were forwarded to the Dev Team.

For the networking side we decided it was best to move onto another networking solution. Initial tests on the Windows version of the game showed everything to be functioning correctly. After some time though, we noticed that on a Linux server it would stop receiving data after a few minutes and cease to function. Working closely with the networking library creator, they were able to determine the problem and noted it was only in Unity version 2018.3. Unity version 2019.1 is free of this issue however another problem was found, the project would crash on startup with Linux builds due to an engine bug.

This new issue is not only affecting our game but others as well and we have reached out on the Unity forums to hopefully find more insight to the issue. 

[h1][u][b]What's happening now? - The Future [/b][/u][/h1]

With everything said, we are still actively working on the game by improving gameplay mechanics and fixing some security issues. We also have that juicy MP2 update ready to go as soon as the networking issues are fixed.

[b]From everyone at Northwood Studios we would like to thank;[/b]

[b]Vis2k[/b] for helping immensely with trying to fix the networking issues.

The people on the Unity forums for helping wherever they could.

Our wonderful Patreon supporters for sticking with us during these trying times.

And finally everyone who has continued to play the game and make the community a wonderful place, we can never thank you enough.

It's been a while since we had one of these, after searching the artwork tab for a while, I believe I found our winner!

[u][b]Secure. Contain. Protect.[/b][/u]

notes.title: Changelog - 8.0.0 - Megapatch Part I
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/0078078a2f4f09125eeff0209579f25d5aada0db.png[/img]

[b]Version 8.0.0[/b]

After a long wait, we are glad to announce part 1 of the Megapatch is ready to be launched! The patch will be released within 24 hours since now! (we're targeting 10:00-12:00am PST). The final release date will be announced on our Discord server (www.discord.gg/scpsl)
Find out what’s heading your way below.

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][u][h1]Return of SCP-079[/h1][/u]

[u][b]SCP-079 is back with some new abilities and toys to play with![/b][/u]
[i]Please note, that SCP-079's development isn't finished yet . We have to collect feedback to make a solid plan of the further development.[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Movement[/b] - 079 can now use 3 modes to move around, which are:
[list]
[*]Map - activated with tab, allows 079 to click on rooms and move there
[*]WASD - changes with your camera rotation, for example, W will move you to the camera in front of you
[*]Clicking cameras - the old way of doing things, 079 can just click the camera icons to move to his next location
[/list]
[*][b]079’s HUD[/b] - completely reworked, including more necessary information
[*][b]Ability usage[/b] - SCP-079 now uses a power called “Auxiliary Power” that recharges over time, it works like mana, that can be used to activate 079's abilities
[*][b]Experience[/b] - can be earned by performing actions or simply assisting human kills. Leveling up increases the AP regeneration and unlocks new abilities.
[*][b]Camera movement modes[/b] - There are 2 ways of rotating (looking around) your cameras, switchable using spacebar.
[*][b]Tesla gates[/b] - SCP-079 can now use tesla gates to his advantage, by using a single instant burst instead of a massive overcharge; practically, we've found it much more efficient than the previous one
[*][b]Locking doors[/b] - now instead of a constant time, the door will be indefinitely locked with a constant power decay until 079 presses right-click or runs out of Aux Power.
[*][b]New ability[/b] - 079 can now shut down all the power in a room, turning off the lights and locking the doors.
[*][b]Zone-specific camera models[/b], that actually rotate, and tell you if SCP-079 is looking at you.
[*][b]Elevators[/b] - 079 can send an elevator up/down to disadvantage his enemies.
[*][b]New recontainment system[/b] - There are five generators placed all around the HCZ. These will power up 079 each time they are turned on. However, if all are turned on, a mini-event will occur, where 079 begins to be "fried" out of the facility hardware, gaining a lot of power temporarily before dying. [b]These generators require Weapon Manager Tablets to operate.[/b]
[/list]

----------------

[*][u][h1]Weapon System Changes[/h1][/u]
[list]

[*][h1]New weapon: USP[/h1]
A new "tool" for those pesky Class D's!
We've added a USP gun, that can hold a couple more attachments than the previous pistol!
Beware though, only one will spawn and hold its true glory.

[*][h1]Weapon attachment changes[/h1]

Get ready with those tablets, weapon attachments are now persistent.
What does this mean?, you may be thinking.

Any weapons dropped by fellow players will retain the attachments that player had set on them. 
Fancy an E-11 with a scope, while wanting a Red Dot sight for CQC? Now you can! (Just be sure to pick, or modify the carefully 'obtained' second rifle!)
You now need to hold the weapon you wish to modify.

[*][h1]General improvements[/h1]
We’ve also balanced the attachments, improved holo sight effects, and E-11 SR shaders.
[/list]
----------------

[*][u][h1]General changes[/h1][/u]
[list]
[*][b]C.A.S.S.I.E.[/b] - announces more detailed information about SCP deaths, telling what killed it specifically (i.e. kill by a Tesla Gate, Warhead detonation, etc).
[*][b]Major Scientist keycard[/b] can open checkpoints now!
[*][b]Respawn system[/b] - has had a few tweaks and changes to improve the queue and way it decides who will spawn in each wave. Spectators chances to respawn increase with the awaiting time.
[*][b]New Permission Manager[/b] - allows you to control and set in-game roles via RA. (Use with command PM)
[*][b]Broadcast/bc command[/b] - allows you to send a message to all players through the Remote Admin!
[*][b]Hiding UI[/b] - You can now hide the UI! Do so by pressing “P”.
[*][b]Engine, Steam & Voice Chat Update[/b] - General updates to our systems have been made, and stability of the voice chat has been improved.
[/list]

[*][u][h1]Bugfixes[/h1][/u]
Thanks to your feedbacks, here are the bugs that got fixed in this release:
[list]
[*]-1HP/One shot bug on self-hosted servers fixed
[*]Fall damage in 106 room when exiting the Pocket Dimention fixed
[*]Playerlist was sometimes shown empty. Fixed
[*]Fall damage when gliding against a surface fixed
[*]Fall damage in elevators when jumping fixed
[*]MicroHID locking the inventory fixed
[*]Standing on a locker's door in the Entrance zone won't trigger the anti-cheat anymore
[*]The janitor card can now be given through the Give Item command
[/list]

If you notice a bug that wasn't reported, feel free to let us know on the Steam forum.

[/list]

----------------

notes.title: Change log - Many things - the biggest update so far!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/5a1f5e03e80674ef2109005da5f0c260ac57efcf.png[/img]

[b]Open Beta v5.0.0[/b]

Hey folks!

You've been waiting for a new update almost a month. The update is coming out today in 6.5h! (10:00 PST / 17:00 GMT+0). The update is already available on the public beta branch, so you can test it before the release! :)

This changelog contains one new feature on the very beginning, the rest is copied from the previously published announcement.

[h1][b]Gameplay features:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Decontamination process[/b] - The Light Containment Zone will automatically close after 15 minutes from the start of the round. This should limit the amount of D-Bois prolonging the game and kill every SCP trapped in locked rooms.

[*][b]Class-specific ragdolls[/b] - each class now has its own dead body, instead of zombie-like ragdoll.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/bdc70bc3939723213a0b4308f0e5231cd099d7d4.png[/img]

[*][b]Keybinding options[/b] - a lot of you were asking about that, here you are!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/45723b6391a619e6665659653c19d1f70da04dea.png[/img]

[*][b]New warhead detonation announcer[/b] - a lot of people asked for a male announcer. Every time I change an actor opinions are divided, he is an official actor, so your complaining has no point ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)
If you like it - I'm glad, otherwise uninstall the game (Don't do it, I will cry all night).

[url=https://youtu.be/__C6EwMw7I8] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/5336726d075a2fce55dff52d864964c32f25354b.png[/img] [/url]

[*][b]Blood[/b] - the following screenshot was created without using any additional tools (I added just a blur effect)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/71e4538b617845f8c635ce74ae6bf0987f69f854.png[/img]

[*][b]It is possible to close alpha warhead doors again[/b], but they open permanently after the detonation.
[/list]

----------------

[h1][b]Bugfixes and minor changes:[/b][/h1]

[*]Intel crashes significantly minimalized! (yay!)
[*]Voice Chat crashes also minimalized! (also yay!)
[*]ESC closes the game console
[*]Grenades now once again damage SCPs!
[*]Other SCPs cannot recontain SCP-106
[*]Main Menu Theme has been slightly refined
[*]Spectator fixes - the list refreshes itself automatically and you can't see the spectating player's head in your camera.
[/list]

----------------

[h1][b]Security and other internal technical features:[/b][/h1]
[*]Ban system reworked (using Steam ID instead of Hardware ID, new storage format).
[*]Added whitelist
[*]Automatic port forwarding by UPnP.
[*]Forwarded server console to game console, when server is not dedicated.
[*]Server verification fixes.
[*]Anticheat improvements.

[/list]

----------------

With Best Regards,
~Hubert Moszka (Project CEO)

Discord forum: [url=https://discord.gg/scpsl]discord.gg/scpsl[/url]

notes.title: (Inter)Comm Update #10b - Additional information
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/5a1f5e03e80674ef2109005da5f0c260ac57efcf.png[/img]

[h1]Hello again![/h1]

Now as you all know The Lion our Project Manager has decided to take a leave of absence. In his place I am now the acting Project Manager until he decides otherwise. Just because Lion has left it doesn't mean the whole project is on hold. Hubert (our Project Head) and the staff team are still working diligently to bring this game to it's full potential. Now I understand that communication between us (the staff) and you (the community) hasn't been as candid and crystal clear as it could be which is what I'm striving to establish now as the new Project Manager. So with that said time to uphold my end of the bargain. A major staff reallocation and overhaul is taking place internally right now, we are changing the hierarchy a lot to suit our current position and at the request of the a lot of community mem(e)bers. It's also my pleasure to announce that in the near future we are also going to have discord integration! So it's now much easier to join your friends on servers! With that I bid you adieu. Any questions regarding decisions and current standing can be sent to me via discord and the suggestion email w.vanvelsen@scpslgame.com. Thank you for your time!

~Your new Project Manager,
Scot

notes.title: Inter(Comms) Update #8 - New Changelog, Patreon and more!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/5a1f5e03e80674ef2109005da5f0c260ac57efcf.png[/img]

[b]Open Beta v1.0.0[/b]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[b]Major features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Completely new map generator! Get lost in the facility every round, you foolish D-Classes!
[*]New door models + information about the required levels of permissions. We’re finally diversifying, hail the doors! (Or cry, when they deny you access.)
[*]Custom footsteps for different classes. I’d run if you hear 106.
[*]New server browser system – working “server info”, number of players, less risk of bypassing the security. IT’S HAPPENING, CALM DOWN!
[*]Remote Admin update - much faster and friendlier.
[*]SCP-079 temporary removal – It’s awaiting the new overhaul with some SSD disks, yum.
[*]Optimization! Less lag, more fun!
[*]New flashlight model. Shine into your friend’s face because you’re an inherent bad boy!
[*]Server name filters.
[/list]

The new update is going to be released around ~6 p.m. GMT +1 on 8 February.

[h1]Patreon![/h1]
We've released our Patreon! Always wanted to support this project, but never knew how? Money is the new option!

Spare a few bucks if you'd like to our license costs, every donation is much appreciated!

https://www.patreon.com/HubertMoszka

[h1]Development Team:[/h1]
I'm working with Hubert to integrate more Developers into the official development process (AKA Unity Collab). This means that issues will be addressed faster, Suggestions will be worked on faster and we'll be able to get more done in less time! Efficiency, yay!

This new plan is intended to be rolled out in the next few weeks.

That's all for this week!

Best regards,
Lion & Hubert

notes.title: (Inter)Comms Update #7 - We've not forgotten!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/5a1f5e03e80674ef2109005da5f0c260ac57efcf.png[/img]

[b]Large wall of text incoming![/b]

[h1]*Tap tap* Is this thing on? Yes? Oh, good. Ahem, this is a proclamation from the O5's responsible for this project. We've not forgotten you![/h1]

However, things have been slow recently. And I know we promised you within 50 hours of the last update to push out another update, but we are planning a huge update with the new map generator, new door design and some other great features (which shall remain under Level 5 - Thaumiel clearance!). This means that it takes more time. I hope you can all have the patience for that.

We've seen a lot of complaints about micro-updates, and I've spoke to Hubert about it. For less-than-essential updates (any update not featuring critical bug fixes) we will attempt to make them bigger and more spaced out. It can still occur that you suddenly get an update, which means we fixed a critical issue as a result of the updates.

As far as the development of the game, and its pace goes, I'm working with Hubert to slowly integrate a team-based structure, where developers get to work in one of the teams best suited to their skillset. This could be network protection or it could be theoretical research into new SCP's (Yes, we're working on, but those developers are working under an non-disclosure agreement, so no point asking ;) ).

What else is exciting is that I've formally hired Grover_c13, the author of the popular tool Multi-Admin, in the development team, which means that at some point we hope to integrate Multi-Admin into the game, but that's a way's off.

[h1]Something else entirely...[/h1]
I've recently (in the past week) been promoted to Project Manager, which means I am now directly below Hubert, and have gained access to a like-minded permission system. I do not develop nor code for this project, but I help structurally in setting developers up and facilitating to the things they need to do their job properly.

I enjoy the new title immensely as it gives me a whole new perspective (and respect!) for the currently on-going development procedures.

This, however, means I'll be distancing myself more and more from directly engaging with the Community. Whereas previously that was my sole task, it now becomes something I can no longer give my undivided attention.

That is why I'm happy to announce that Eviction Notice is from here on out the Deputy Community Manager, reporting directly to me. He will take over most of my tasks in the Community, such as training the new moderators and maintaining the procedures in place for this Community.

It's painful for me to take a step back from what I did with a lot of passion, for the short time it might have been. That doesn't mean I'm out of reach though! On my profile is a wide array of ways to reach me, but I will not comment on suggestions, requests for status updates, and more of that.

I'll still be doing these announcements from time to time when I have time, though.

In hopes of having informed you enough with this announcement, I take my leave.

Best regards,
The Lion
Project Manager

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/5a1f5e03e80674ef2109005da5f0c260ac57efcf.png[/img]

Hey guys, how are you all doing?

It's me again. (Yes, again Jim!)

So what am I going to be rambling about today? Well, not much, actually! We figured that instead of giving you pre-translated changelog hours ahead of an update, why not do it in a video?!

The video showcases our latest work, of which some (or all, look at Hubert) features will be presented in the next update.

We've been consistent with our Roadmap with this video, so let us know what you think!

Video link: https://youtu.be/4udBcmu2PAc

I'll be posting a changelog in advance for this update once Hubert sends me the document.

I'm going to end this announcement with another featured artwork commission.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/5510b63229f7213ea9280c60b743db3874b1405c.jpg[/img]
[i]It would appear we have a problem...[/i]

See you guys soon!

~Lion

notes.title: (Inter)Comm Update 4: You asked for it! You got it!

Hey folks! It's me again, and I'm here with some great news!

[b]We're ready to publish our first roadmap for the next 3 months![/b]

Now, before we go on with this, I want to put in a word of caution that whatever is currently put up in the roadmap is subject to change on any data, including release date and exact specifics about the goal at mind.

[i]1 has the highest priority, 4 has the lowest, etc.[/i]

My apologies for the watermark in advance. It's a great program, but costs a lot to use for commercial ends.

[h1]An additional note:[/h1]

We have just concluded our first batch of Moderators trainings, with eight moderators ready to help us keep the Discussions a friendly and toxic-free place. Give 'em a round of applause!

~The Lion

notes.title: Comm Update 2: Applications. Applications everywhere!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/5a1f5e03e80674ef2109005da5f0c260ac57efcf.png[/img]

Ahoy folks, I'm back here again.

I wish to make note of a few things;

[h1]Community Moderator Applications:[/h1]
As some (really just a lot) people may know, I have opened up applications to give me a hand in the form of Community Moderation, both domestic and foreign.

They close tomorrow at 17:00 (5 p.m.) GMT +1. Another announcement will be made tomorrow night somewhere confirming the moderators that were accepted.

[h1]Development:[/h1]

I know a LOT of you have great suggestions, and I do see them flying by. I also know there is an equal amount of annoying bugs. I wish to state the following; we acknowledge every bug, but do not offer official correspondence from us in a development capacity on all bugs. Same goes for Suggestions.

As another small sidenote, I will be having a meeting with Hubert next week to discuss a roadmap. I [b]cannot guarantee any outcome from that chat, though. So please, keep your hopes in a vice for now.[/b]

[h1]Lastly, I want to address cheaters:[/h1]

Horrible, first of all. I know it's absolutely game ruining, and I sincerely apologise on behalf of the team to every player affected out there by now. I know Hubert is aware of the issue, and has been working on it to make sure the game increases in anti-cheat stability. Remind yourselves that even if this is never mentioned, it is one of the primary things I'm thinking about at all times.

For now, I'm afraid all I can offer is a measly Google Form. If you are a server owner, or have been victim of a cheater, please take the time to fill out this form. 

https://goo .gl/forms/V9HfKAl785u8m9z03 (when pasting into your browser don't forget to remove the space before .gl)

And with that I'm closing tonight off, and thank all of you for being so loyal to this project. Your loyalty means everything to us!

Best regards,
El león with a Spanish name for fun.

notes.title: Comm Update 1: It's been done! (Some) Servers are now verified!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/5a1f5e03e80674ef2109005da5f0c260ac57efcf.png[/img]

Hey folks, it's me again!

[h1]The verification process:[/h1]

Boy, that was one heck of a night! I've been working to reduce our backlog of server verification requests. I've sifted through 128 e-mails, and I have finally reached the end of the mailbox.

All applications have now received an official response that their server has been verified or not.

I want to apologise for the slow response times.

From this point on, I will be verifying servers every Monday from 10 p.m. to 12:01 a.m., and Sunday from 8 p.m. to 12:01 a.m. All times are GMT+1. Make sure your server is on during this time.

[h1]Other work:[/h1]

As you all can likely see, I'm trying my best that every player and server comes to their right to play this game, and to make this game into an even bigger experience. Hence, I have been asking around for permission for a few things.

One of them is to "hire" (Free, of course) my own community team to fill the hub with. I'll be figuring out how to handle the application process over the next few days.

Next, I wanted to introduce a couple of segments, which is featured artwork. Did you make some artwork you want to show off? That's great! I hope to have an e-mail to send it to soon, so expect that in the next announcement.

With this I want to close off my work day (night, really!) and leave you guys with one piece of featured artwork already sent in by the talented mapper720. Thank you for this great piece of art!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/45fffef811d087bf1177a7f160f7dd8cf40f4768.jpg[/img]
[i]What could possibly go wrong?[/i]

notes.title: Changelog - Bugfixes & "Local Admin" Control Panel
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31380022/5a1f5e03e80674ef2109005da5f0c260ac57efcf.png[/img]

[b]Open Beta 0.4.1[/b]

Hello folks! The new update is due to arrive today between 6 and 7 p.m. GMT +1. Here is the changelog in advance. Don't forget to keep your servers up to date!

[h1]Major change: Updated Dedicated Server Control Panel;[/h1]
[list]
[*]Name changed from "Server Manager" to "Local Admin".
[*]Servers are now protected from crashes! Those damn bugs are being shaken off...
[*]You can now host dual (more than one!) servers. Double trouble!
[*]The Local Admin Panel has a friendly UI and is user-oriented.
[/list]

[h1]Minor features;[/h1]
[list]
[*]Minor redesign of the main menu with some added details. Spot the changes and... There's nothing to win!
[*]Ability to change the server ports. Now you can run it on 106, 173, 079, er... Wait, that can't be right.
[*]Micro HID and Positron Grenades fixed. They now deal damage again.
[*]Fixed server lag when recontaining SCP-106! You can now put him back in that cage, where he belongs, without fear of being punished for it by the server!
[/list]

[h1]Notes;[/h1]
[list]
[*]For all you Penguin lovers out there, we have good news! Linux server support is coming soon!
[/list]
